title: Honor confirms massive batteries for Win2 and Win RT2
description: The Honor Win2 series, comprising the Win2, Win RT2, and Win Turbo 2, is set to launch in China next week. After revealing the designs and color options of all three phones yesterday, Honor has now confirmed some of their key specifications. Honor has confirmed that the Win2 will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. The phone will pack a 10,100mAh battery and feature a 2K resolution display with a 185Hz refresh rate and 5,920Hz PWM dimming. Honor claims that the Win2’s new dual-turbo cooling system can reduce temperatures by up to 10 degrees Celsius in just...

title: Samsung adds support for new languages across Galaxy AI features and Bixby
description: Samsung is expanding language support across several Galaxy AI features and Bixby starting today. The updates will initially focus on features that help users translate, summarize, and transcribe content. In a press release, Samsung confirmed that Galaxy AI features such as Call Assist, Interpreter, Note Assist, and Transcript Assist will add support for Malay and Hungarian. Live Translate in Hungarian With the addition of the two new languages, Live Translate will support a total of 24 languages. Samsung’s Now Nudge feature will also gain support for 8 new languages, bringing...

title: vivo X500 E's design and key specs revealed through Google Play Console listing
description: Last week, we spotted the vivo X500 E on Bluetooth SIG's website with model designation V2656. Now, it has appeared on Google Play Console with key specs and an image. The image included in the Google Play Console listing reveals the vivo X500 E has a flat display with a 2,750x1,260-pixel resolution and a centered punch-hole for the selfie camera, but its diagonal and panel type aren't mentioned. The X500 E has 8GB of RAM onboard and is powered by Qualcomm's SM7750 chip, which is the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 SoC. Previous rumors claimed the vivo X500 E would have the Dimensity 9500 SoC...

title: Samsung Health update improves Sleep Coaching and Running Coach
description: Samsung Health has had Sleep Coaching for a while now, but getting it going required a full week of sleep data collected within a month. Today, Samsung announced an update to the app that cuts that requirement down, makes the coaching more personalized, and brings a few new features for runners as well. You can now start Sleep Coaching with just three days of sleep data from the past two weeks. During setup, you fill out a survey about your sleep regularity, interruptions, alcohol and caffeine intake, and how satisfied you are with your sleep. Based on that and your sleep data, the app...

title: Check out the first Oppo Find X10 Pro Max and Find X10 camera samples
description: Our reviews of the global Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max are still ongoing. We already shared an unboxing, but now we can share some of our camera samples with you guys. But before we get to samples, we have a quick side-by-side between the Find X10 Pro Max and the Pixel 11 Pro, over on TikTok. As usual, we're saving our full and detailed analysis for our review. But you're welcome to draw your own conclusions based on the samples. What we can say is that shooting on the Find X10 series feels virtually as refined as on the Find X9 Ultra. The camera interface is snappy,...

title: Realme phone with OnePlus 16R-like specs leaks, contradicts earlier camera rumor
description: Earlier today, a leak claimed that the OnePlus 16R is being tested with a triple 50MP rear camera setup, and that a phone with the same hardware is also being tested under the Realme brand. Now, another tipster has chimed in with his own take on that Realme phone, and his details paint quite a different picture. According to him, the Realme phone in question has a 200MP main camera and a 50MP telephoto with 3.5x optical zoom, and he specifically says it doesn't have a triple 50MP setup. Interestingly, there's no ultrawide camera at all. That lines up with what we've been hearing about the...

title: Infinix Note 70 Pro certification helps confirm its major upgrade
description: Infinix launched the Note 60 Pro back in February, and its successor is already starting to show up in certification databases. Today, an Infinix phone with the model number X6766 has appeared in the Eurasian Economic Commission (EEC) database, and the listing also reveals its full marketing name: Note 70 Pro. Like most EEC entries, it covers the phone's encryption paperwork rather than its hardware, so it doesn't reveal any specs. The X6766 model number previously showed up in the GSMA IMEI database back in August, and a DevCheck hardware entry for the same model revealed the...

title: POCO X8 Pro Series: Built for People Who Expect More From Their Smartphones
description: A smartphone can be fast on paper, but what matters more is how that speed shows up in everyday life. It is the difference between a game running smoothly and having to compromise on settings, between moving effortlessly across apps and waiting for things to catch up, and between having enough battery to get through the day and constantly looking for a charger. POCO X8 Pro Max This is where the POCO X8 Pro Series comes in. Built around the idea that performance should make everyday experiences better, the series brings together serious processing power, long-lasting endurance...

title: OnePlus 16R said to offer a triple 50MP rear camera setup
description: The OnePlus 16 recently launched in China, but a leak from September suggested that the flagship may not debut in India. Instead, OnePlus is rumored to launch the 16R in the country, with a new leak now revealing the phone’s key specs. According to the leak, the OnePlus 16R is currently in the Production Validation Test (PVT) phase and is being tested with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. OnePlus 15R The phone is tipped to feature a triple rear camera setup comprising a 50MP primary sensor, a 50MP ultrawide camera, and a 50MP telephoto unit. If accurate, this would be a...

title: Poco X8s receives another certification ahead of its launch
description: Poco has already launched four phones in its X8 family this year: the X8 Pro and X8 Pro Max in March, then the vanilla X8 and the X8 Power in early September. A fifth one is reportedly coming, and today it moved a step closer to launch. A phone with the model number 2609CPC5FG has been approved by Singapore's IMDA. The listing names Poco as the brand and Xiaomi Electronics as the applicant, and it describes the device as a 5G mobile phone with Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and NFC. That's all it says. The same model number has also shown up before in Europe's EEC and IECEE databases, which didn't...

title: Apple starts App Store Indie Games Week with seven new arrivals
description: This week is Indie Games Week in Apple's App Store, a celebration of games made by independent developers. Throughout the week, the App Store will spotlight "indie gems" with daily features and curated collections, and seven "highly acclaimed" titles are making their debut on iPhone and iPad, either available for download now or up for pre-order. The first one Apple highlights is Sifu, the third-person kung fu brawler from Sloclap and Kepler Interactive. It arrives "fully adapted" for mobile, with custom-tuned touch controls, a reworked camera system, and full controller support. Then...

title: OnePlus 16 sells over 70,000 units in its first hour of availability
description: The OnePlus 16 was unveiled in China on Monday, and it went on sale there this morning at 10 AM local time. Just an hour later, OnePlus China president Li Jie took to Weibo to announce that more than 70,000 units had already been sold. According to the exec, that puts the OnePlus 16 in first place among this year's Android flagships based on comparable launch-period sales, and he calls the result an increase that's rare in the industry. Unfortunately, the company hasn't shared how many units its predecessor sold in the same timeframe, so we can't put that into perspective. In case...

title: Apple's Get Ready service is now available for iPhone Duo pre-orders
description: Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, at its September launch event alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The company will start taking pre-orders for the iPhone Duo on October 16, which is this coming Friday. Shipping will then start on October 23, exactly one week later. Since the iPhone Duo is expected to be available in rather limited quantities at first, if you really want one, then you should use Apple's Get Ready service, which has just been made available for the iPhone Duo pre-orders. This lets you select all of your options ahead of...

title: Samsung survey reveals how Europeans pick their smartphones
description: Samsung has just published the results of a survey on how Europeans choose which smartphone to buy. It covered 5,001 consumers aged 18 and over in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the UK. According to the findings, people pick a phone based on what they do today, but also on what they'd like to be doing in the future. 66% of those surveyed chose their current phone with at least one interest they wanted to pursue in mind. These ranged from entertainment and side hustles to gaming, travel, and content creation. Almost half (46%) consider their ambitions when making technology choices, and...

title: Apple's HomePod mini 2 is here with Siri AI, new colors and improved sound
description: Alongside the new Apple HomeView, upgraded Apple TV 4K, and Apple Home Collection, the company also unveiled the HomePod mini 2. The updated smart speaker brings Siri AI, a new Sound Glow feature, support for pairing up to 4 speakers, and new color options. The HomePod mini 2 is powered by the company’s S10 chip, which enables its new Siri AI features. Apple says that Siri AI will require the speaker to be paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad. Siri AI will be able to recognize up to six users based on their voice and offer personalized messages. However, these...

title: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable AI models yet
description: Meta started a ground-up overhaul of its AI efforts 14 months ago, and the first result was Muse Spark, which the company used to lay out its approach to "predictable, rigorous scaling". Now, Meta has taken what it calls "the next step" on its "scaling ladder" with the Muse Wonder series, made up of Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Meta says these are its most capable models, delivering "state-of-the-art performance on personal and professional agentic tasks". They were trained at the company's gigawatt-scale Prometheus data center, and they accept text, image, video, and audio as input...

title: Apple Home Collection launches with LG and Schneider cameras, thermostats, and sensors
description: Apple had a busy day today. The company introduced its HomeView smart display, the next-generation Apple TV 4K, and the HomePod mini 2, all with Siri AI. Alongside those, it also announced the Apple Home Collection, a range of smart home accessories co-developed with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric. The lineup includes four LG cameras, an LG smart lock, two smart thermostats (one each from LG and Schneider Electric), and a temperature sensor from each of the two companies. Every device is set up with a single tap of an iPhone and controlled entirely from the Home app or with Siri, so...

title: Apple announces HomeView with a 7-inch touchscreen and Siri with Apple Intelligence
description: Apple today announced the HomeView, the company's upcoming smart home hub powered by the new Siri. It will be available in desktop and wall-mounted designs and will be available next month. The standard HomeView model features a floating display design with a rounded aluminum base. The display is hinged and is tilt-adjustable. It will be available in four colors: silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray, each with a matching cable. The wall-mounted model only features the display module and will offer a choice of different mounts from Schneider Home. It will only be...

title: The new Apple TV 4K uses the A19 chipset and supports Siri AI, but the price tag is killer
description: Apple’s big smart home event is in full swing and among all the new gadgets is the Apple TV 4K (4th gen). We’ll start by ripping off the band-aid – the new model costs double the launch price of the 3rd gen model from 2022 (and that’s if you look at the 128GB model with Ethernet!). There is some good news, at least – the new model is massively more capable than the one it replaces. It is powered by the Apple A19 chipset, the one inside the iPhone 17. The performance uplift from the A15 chip inside the 2022 model is massive – the CPU is 50% faster and the GPU is 2x faster. More...

title: AnTuTu September ranking is out, Xiaomi leads in flagships and tablets categories
description: Continuing its tradition, AnTuTu has published data that shows which devices topped its performance charts in the flagship, mid-range, and tablet categories. The numbers are for September and are based on data collected in China. Moreover, the AnTuTu 12 benchmark scores included in its charts are averages of those devices, not peak scores. In the flagship category, Xiaomi topped the chart with the Xiaomi 18 Fold, which has an average score of 4,620,886 and is powered by the XRing O3. The Xiaomi 18 Fold is followed by the iQOO 16 and Honor Magic9 Pro Max, both powered by the Snapdragon 8...
